text:
mira: Heads up — packaging pipeline stalled, deploybot queued but signing failing due to KMS rotation in us-west. We have a tonight canary for ACME at 21:00 UTC. Need decision: evacuate signer or pin previous signed installer?
packaging-bot: Signature job 4821 failed: cosign error: signer not available. Artifact left in staging: s3://redwood-packaging/staged/3172. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/packaging/4821
deploybot: deploybot: job 3172000000-transport-stage queued -> BLOCKED on 'signer-available'. Auto-retry disabled.
sam: I can try the KMS handoff with infra, but rotation might still be mid-flight. If so, recommend pin + canary hold. Which customers are on tonight's window?
mira: Affected: ACME, BetaCorp, Gamma (all private/VPC installs). ACME is the canary at 21:00 UTC; others later in the night.
jordan: For a fast unblock: release a shrinkwrap pointing at the previous signed bundle sha and set manifest `pin: v2026-03-10`. Deploybot can push transport with a pinned manifest. If we pin we need a quick security acknowledgement in the release notes.
arun: I can produce the pin file. To verify checksum run: ```sha256sum sealed-bundle-v2026-03-10.tar.gz``` Proposed manifest fragment: `{"manifest.pin":"v2026-03-10"}`. I'll stage s3://redwood-packaging/pins/pin-3172.json when agreed.
liz: If we pin, I need to prep a customer-facing note and a short release note entry: 'Temporary pin due to KMS rotation; full signed release will follow.' Should we notify CS now?
mira: Option B is evacuate the carrier and retarget deploybot to eu-central signer. Evac adds ~10-15m ops work but avoids customer-visible pin. Which do we prefer?
sam: Evac preferred if @ops_lead signs off. Evac path: update deploybot routing flag `--signer eu-central-signer-2` and set TTL 1h.
ops_lead: I approve evacuation. I'll update routing and coordinate with infra to ensure no cross-region KMS blinding. Setting maintenance flag on packaging service for the window.
deploybot: deploybot: rerouting job -> signer eu-central-signer-2. Job resumed, upload in progress. ETA ~9m.
mira: Great — @liz hold the CS note until we validate upload succeeded. If it does, we'll still add a follow-up explaining the alternate signer and audit.
sam: If reroute fails, fallback to pin + notify. I'll open the pin PR now so it's ready.
packaging-bot: Signed bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-packaging/releases/sealed-bundle-v2026-03-17-signed.tar.gz  cosign: OK. sha256: abcdef1234567890deadbeefcafebeef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef
mira: Confirmed. Canaries for ACME are green to go at 21:00. Thanks everyone :tada:
liz: Drafted the customer note and release note blurb. Will send on green. Also adding a bullet to the release notes: 'Signed release temporarily routed to alternative signer during KMS rotation; audit to follow.'
deploybot: deploybot: job 3172000000 completed. transport state: DELIVERED to ACME canary. Deploy logs: https://deploybot.redwood.internal/jobs/3172000000/logs
mira: Closing thread. After-hours followup: collect postmortem details in #postmortems if anything to record.
